'''Imperial Forward Command''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] that was commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Zasha Ranken]]. The brainchild of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]], Forward Command carried out focused, high-risk offensives against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and its allies, and had complete autonomy under Ranken's leadership.
